description: Draft. Identities (RFC 07 section 13.1) whose seed starts with a character on which ECMAScript's String.prototype.trim, which section 13.1 names, and Python's str.strip differ: U+FEFF (removed by trim only), U+0085 and U+001C (removed by str.strip only). The expected values are BioChain-AI's computeIdentityId; the independent implementation (the Lexicon's attest.py, which uses str.strip) gives other identities, so the suite stays draft (RFC 07 section 17).

cases.note: U+FEFF is ECMAScript white space, so trim removes it and the identity is identity_trimmed_seed's; Python's str.strip keeps it
U+0085 (NEL) is not ECMAScript white space, so trim keeps it; Python's str.strip removes it
U+001C (FS) is not ECMAScript white space, so trim keeps it; Python's str.strip removes it
